title.zh: AI 音乐工具与工作流程

lead.zh: 按任务核对工具能力、输入输出、后期衔接与使用条件。
lead.en: Compare capabilities, inputs, outputs, production hand-offs and terms by task.

needs_title.en: Which job is on your desk

needs_sub.zh: 每张卡先给判断标准，再给两三条能直接读的条目。
needs_sub.en: Each card gives the test first, then two or three entries to read next.

d.zh: 先定风格与结构，再决定哪些段落交给模型。全程能改，比一次生成好听更重要。
d.en: Fix style and structure first, then decide which sections to hand to a model. Staying editable matters more than a lucky first take.

t.en: Score a film or a game

d.zh: 配乐先对齐画面与状态，再谈音乐性。交付格式、循环点和授权要一开始就写清楚。
d.en: Picture and game state come before musicality. Delivery format, loop points and licensing need to be settled at the start.

t.zh: 已有素材，想修、分轨或母带
t.en: Repair, separate or master existing audio

d.zh: 先判断问题是素材、编曲还是处理链。分轨能解决什么、会留下什么痕迹，要事先知道。
d.en: Decide whether the problem is the source, the arrangement or the chain. Know what separation can fix and what artefacts it leaves.

d.zh: 咬字、换气与情感比音高更难仿。涉及真人声音时，同意与授权先于效果。
d.en: Diction, breath and intent are harder to fake than pitch. With a real person's voice, consent comes before quality.

t.en: Can I use it, and how do I credit it

d.zh: 把平台条款、训练来源和输出权利分开看。签合同前先确认素材与模型的授权链。
d.en: Separate platform terms, training sources and rights in the output. Check the licensing chain before signing.

t.zh: 怎么判断这次生成值不值得留

d.zh: 盲听、可复现和返工成本是三把尺子。听不出差别时，先别加处理。
d.en: Blind listening, reproducibility and rework cost are the three tests. If you cannot hear a difference, stop processing.

d.zh: 数据不出门、中文咬字、按次付费，是三条不同的需求；先分清再选。
d.en: Keeping data local, Chinese diction and pay-per-use are three different needs; separate them before choosing.

ladder_sub.zh: 从定目标到交付，四步走完；每一步都可以停下来检查。
ladder_sub.en: Four steps from brief to delivery; each one has a checkpoint.

d.zh: 时长、用途、格式、响度与授权，先落在纸上。
d.en: Length, use, format, loudness and licence, written down first.

d.zh: 按工作结果选，不按模型热度选。
d.en: Choose by the result you need, not by model hype.

d.zh: 结构、速度、配器、禁用的声音，逐项写进去。
d.en: Structure, tempo, instrumentation and forbidden sounds, named one by one.

d.zh: 换设备、对参考曲、查响度与分轨命名。
d.en: Change systems, compare with a reference, check loudness and stem names.

picks_sub.zh: 六条覆盖选型、控制、分轨、评估与授权。
picks_sub.en: Six entries covering selection, control, stems, evaluation and licensing.

why.zh: 先看清工具地图：哪些做歌、哪些做分轨、哪些只做母带。
why.en: See the map first: which tools make songs, which separate stems, which only master.

why.zh: 把“一次生成”拆成可检查的工序。
why.en: Turns one generation into a sequence you can inspect.

why.zh: 提示词的结构比形容词堆砌更管用。
why.en: Structure beats piled-up adjectives in a prompt.

why.zh: 分轨之前先知道它会留下什么痕迹。
why.en: Know the artefacts before you split anything.

why.zh: 有些活交给模型只会增加返工。
why.en: Some jobs only get more rework when handed to a model.

why.zh: 商用与署名问题，最好在开工前读完。
why.en: Read the commercial-use and credit rules before you start.

why.zh: 先按四轴排除，再谈音质。
why.en: Filter on four axes before discussing sound.

why.zh: 开放权重、整曲生成，门槛在显存与许可。
why.en: Open weights and full songs, with VRAM and licence gates.

why.zh: 长文本、章节与质检，和做歌是两套流程。
why.en: Long text, chapters and QC: a different pipeline from songs.

trails_sub.zh: 每条四到五站，顺序读，不用跳。
trails_sub.en: Four or five stops each; read in order.

d.zh: 从结构到母带，盯住每个可交付节点。
d.en: From structure to master, with a deliverable at each stop.

d.zh: 先对画面，再谈风格，最后处理授权。
d.en: Picture first, style second, licensing last.

t.en: Tell models, tools and services apart

d.zh: 同样叫 AI 音乐，能力边界完全不同。
d.en: All called AI music, with very different limits.
